name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
summary: At the top of The Ensorcelled Parchment, Nagaz is the only name clear. A spell hides the rest, so you take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: A Spell-Veiled Parchment
sections.body: A spell keeps the parchment's writing from being read. Only Nagaz can be made out at the top. You take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: What Dibbs Makes of It
sections.body: Dibbs asks if the parchment holds more encrypted notes. He wishes he could decipher every odd scrap of writing that drifts out of Alterac. But he admits he lacks the knowledge.

faq.q: What is written on the parchment?
aliases: what does the ensorcelled parchment say
faq.answer: A spell hides the writing, except for one word at the top: Nagaz.
Show the parchment to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore. He takes in scraps of lore gathered from the mountains.
